keypoints_uv_to_points — REPRCONV keypoint op

• Data kinds: keypoints → points

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.keypoints_uv_to_points(keypoints, z=0.0) (to call the implementation directly, import reprconv; reprconv.keypoints_uv_to_points(keypoints, z=0.0); from the registry, opsreprconv.get("keypoints_uv_to_points"))

Usage

Image coordinates (N,2) = (u, v) → a point set (N,3) = (z, y, x). The exit from keypoints.

The axis convention is written in the op name because in this repo the producer of keypoints, match3d.project_points, returns (u, v) = (column, row), and the producer of points, fuse3d.to_points(voxel), returns (z, y, x) -- connecting them naively as "the first 2 columns" swaps rows and columns without any exception or NaN. Here y = v and x = u are swapped explicitly before passing on.

Round trip with points_zyx_to_keypoints_uv is bit-identical (in the direction where z is passed).

Args:

keypoints: (N, 2) (u, v).

z: z of the plane to place them on (a scalar, or an (N,) array).

Returns:

(N, 3) float64 (z, y, x).

Raises:

ValueError: invalid shape / non-finite / length of z does not match.
